OUR HISTORY

Always moving.
Always connecting.

From our beginnings in 1997 to a global roaming ecosystem. Explore selected milestones.

↓
SELECTED MILESTONES

A history of what’s next.

  1. 1997

    Comfone begins

    The company is established with roots in Swisscom and Vodafone.

  2. 2004

    The Key2roam Hub

    The hub begins connecting the roaming community.

  3. 2011

    ConneXion begins

    The first event brings together around 50 participants.

  4. 2012

    A connected platform

    Key2roam and the Pulse business portal bring services together.

  5. 2017

    Data becomes intelligence

    The Data Management Service goes live.

  6. 2018

    ePayments launches

    Financial clearing payments become accessible in real time.

  7. 2022

    25 years of Comfone

    A quarter-century of roaming expertise.

  8. 2024

    20 years of the hub

    Key2roam Hub celebrates two decades of global connections.
